subject: Geopolitics
title: World War Propaganda
description: A short lesson to help you apply World War Propaganda.

hook.text: Uncle Sam points at you: 'I Want YOU for U.S. Army.' One poster recruited four million soldiers. Image is power.

buildup.text: Both World Wars saw governments mobilize media: posters, film, radio, and newspapers all served the war effort.

discovery.text: Nazi Germany perfected propaganda. Riefenstahl's films turned rallies into myth and Hitler into a symbol.

twist.text: Allied propaganda was just as pervasive. The US Office of War Information managed news and imagery to sustain support.

climax.text: The World Wars proved that controlling the narrative is as important as controlling the battlefield. Both win wars.

punchline.text: Win the story and you can recruit the army.

quiz.question: What lesson about propaganda did the World Wars teach?
options: Controlling the narrative is as vital as battlefield control
Print media is the only effective propaganda tool
